"Her Majesty" | | | | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+ | | +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+ | -- | | | -- | | +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+ "Golden Slumbers" is a song by the Beatles, part of the climactic medley on their 1969 album Abbey Road. The song begins the progression that leads to the end of the album and is followed by "Carry That Weight." The two songs were recorded together as a single piece, and both were written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon-McCartney), strings and brass arranged and scored by producer George Martin. ©1969 Sony/ATV Music Publishing LLC.
